densityExpansion.methaneDecision: No new CO2-rich CO2+CH4 density production slice enabled. xCH4=0.1012 and 0.2015 are the CCS-relevant additional Liu slices, but worst deviations are 7.675087% and 2.229510%, exceeding the existing approximately 2% worst-error precedent. Higher methane fractions with lower errors are not CO2-rich CCS operating domains.

hydrogenCompositionSummaries.decisionRationale: Not production-enabled for Advanced CCS Properties because the rows are hydrogen-rich high-temperature gasification conditions, not CO2-rich CCS pipeline/storage conditions, and they do not support expanding the existing CO2-rich xH2 = 0.05362 production gate.

densityExpansion.hydrogenDecision: No new CO2-rich CO2+H2 density production slice enabled. Cheng 2019 validates EOS-CG numerics at xH2=0.6005 and 0.6992, but these hydrogen-rich 673 K gasification states do not support expanding the current CO2-rich xH2=0.05362 CCS domain.

methaneVLEAdditionalComposition.decision: No additional fixed-composition phase-envelope production gate enabled. Petropoulou rows validate saturated liquid/vapor branch points across liquid xCH4 approximately 0.00001-0.11218, but they do not provide an independent fixed-overall-composition envelope domain beyond the existing xCH4=0.05 production gate. The 303.145 K near-critical continuation remains diagnostic.

hydrogenTemperatureInterpolation.decision: Discrete H2 temperatures retained. The Souissi production evidence contains only three experimental isotherms, with no intermediate-temperature numerical rows; smooth endpoint errors alone are insufficient authority to expose continuous interpolation between 273.15 K, 293.15 K and 323.15 K.

caloricProperties.decision: CO2+CH4 and CO2+H2 mixture Cv, Cp and speed of sound remain diagnostic/unavailable to users. The implementation exists, but this bounded pass did not acquire independent primary numerical matrices for production validation.
